input.prompt: Use case: stylized game sprite. Paint OUR Daoist Child's front-facing walk as exactly three original drawings in a single horizontal transparent PNG strip of three equal square cells. Ref 1 is our own exact S-facing character identity. Ref 2 and ref 3 show the stored native phase silhouettes, foot positions and camera only. Refs 4 and 5 set the handcrafted Chinese Daoist Q finish, warm softened contours, amber, ivory and jade. Fixed straight-on camera and eye line. Keep the large round head, soft smile, spiky dark-brown hair, gold headband with a knot and two ribbon tails on screen RIGHT, cream crossover shirt, teal embroidered robe, round belt medallion, pale puff trousers and teal-gold boots. Our child carries a gold double gourd with a taiji medallion and red tassel in the hand on screen RIGHT throughout, with the empty hand on screen LEFT. Keep the same head width, robe hem length, waist height, boot design and foot-floor level across all three. Boots point toward camera, no turns, no lunge and no side-facing pose. Keep every character entirely inside its cell with 12% clear gutter. One character per cell. Keep equal complete body scale and the same standing sole baseline. Actual clear alpha around each silhouette. No background, checkerboard, glow, shadow, lettering, UI, grid, flourishes, source clothing or source hair. Follow the TOP row of refs 2 and 3, read left to right, with modest changes increasing through the walk. f18: both feet side-by-side and flat at the same height, elbows neutral, eyes open. f19: keep the screen RIGHT boot planted at the established baseline, move the screen LEFT boot distinctly higher on the image by a small step, about one half of the boot's height. The raised left boot is foreshortened; show the shortened LEFT leg beneath its left robe opening. Both feet stay in their own column. Both hands low. f20: the screen RIGHT boot stays down, the LEFT boot now sits even higher, visibly behind the planted shoe by close to one whole shoe height. Bring the empty screen LEFT hand and sleeve a little forward and up. Gourd hand remains on screen RIGHT. Distinct soles vertically staggered. Paint each of these three phases as an in-place front walk with the gourd consistent, like the native source viewed straight ahead.
